purpose: Exploratory search for persistent direct polar patterns beyond shared Arg345, without new MD
scope: All 406 receptor residues, all ligand N/O donor/acceptor groups, both hydrogen-bond directions; ARG/LYS/charged HIS and protonated N-terminal cations versus ligand carboxylate.
combinations: Simultaneous AND across distinct receptor residues, all orders reaching frequency threshold. Multiple atom pairs form a union within a residue/ligand-group/direction/sidechain-or-backbone feature.
water_scope: Direct protein-ligand contacts only. Processed inputs exclude solvent; no water-mediated or energetic-strength claim.
interpretation: Passing patterns are single-trajectory candidate anchoring states, not mutant causality or affinity rankings. Full and prespecified sliding windows and all failures retained.
